description: Vasiljevic, Nikola and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented Python campaign-planning library optimises measurement locations, GIS constraints, WindScanner positions and scanning trajectories. Its source description establishes an existing computational tool, and the eWindLidar overview explicitly presents the tool collection as open source. The primary presentation licence applies to its deposited material; inspected metadata do not establish one software licence for every component. This resource supports obtaining model-relevant wind measurements and assessing proposed instrument placement. It is not represented as a general wind-farm simulator. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-sa-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
